subject: Clarify purchase-token assignment, line-item split, and temporary spend cap
messages:
From: Tim Burke <tburke@starlight.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Purchase token request and line split for initial onboarding

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the quick demo — excited to move forward. Procurement on our side asked for a Purchase Order (PO) / purchase reference number to tie to the initial three-month pilot. I attached the onboarding form and a CSV with the proposed SKU-level split for the first invoice.

Two small asks from our finance team: can the PO reflect a temporary spend cap of $20k for March–May while we validate usage, and can line items be issued as two separate tokens (compute / storage) rather than one aggregated line? That helps internal cost center mapping.

Attachment: starlight-ponum-request-form.pdf (form)
Attachment: lineitem-split-proposal.csv (CSV)

Could you confirm who on your side owns issuing the PO number and any expected lead time?

Best,
Tim
Head of Procurement
Starlight AI
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Burke <tburke@starlight.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Purchase token request and line split for initial onboarding

Ben/Karthik — forwarding an onboarding PO request from Starlight. They want: 1) a PO/purchase-ref tied to their account for the pilot, 2) the PO broken into two line items (compute / storage), and 3) a temporary spend cap of $20k for Mar–May.

Ben, can Procurement generate the PO number and map the two SKUs as separate line items? I included the CSV they provided. If we need a different tokenization approach (our internal term: tokenography) to support split billing, flag it here.

Tim — looping you for visibility. We’ll respond with timing within the day.

Monica
Sr. Revenue Operations Associate
Redwood Inference
(attachment: starlight-ponum-request-form.pdf)
(attachment: lineitem-split-proposal.csv)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Burke <tburke@starlight.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Purchase token request and line split for initial onboarding

Monica, Karthik — thanks for the heads up. We can issue a provisional PO/purchase-ref within 48 hours. A few operational notes:

- We can create the PO as two line items (sku: RED-LLM-COMPUTE / RED-LLM-STORAGE) to reflect compute vs storage. I reviewed their CSV and the splits look fine but I’ll request a small normalization (rounding to nearest $10).
- Temporary spend caps are managed at the account token level. To set $20k for Mar–May we need an approved spendcap exception from Finance or a manager-level sign-off in case it’s outside the default onboarding thresholds.
- Attachments are good; will upload to the vendor file.

I’ll provision a draft PO number (PROV-20270330-007) and share it once I’ve normalized the line amounts. Karthik — can you confirm whether we need a formal spendcap exception ticket or if Grace can approve directly?

Ben
Senior Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Tim Burke <tburke@starlight.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Purchase token request and line split for initial onboarding

Ben — Grace can approve one-off spendcap exceptions up to $50k for pilot customers via a quick approval note; we don't need a full Finance ticket unless we exceed that. Monica — please confirm that Starlight acknowledges the provisional nature of the PO (PROV-20270330-007) and agrees to final amounts once we normalize the CSV. Once Grace signs off I’ll convert the provisional PO to a formal, billable purchase reference and apply the $20k spend cap window.

Grace — if you’re OK with the $20k temporary cap for Mar–May, can you reply with approval? Tim — FYI, this means the account will be limited to $20k consumption; any overage will require sign-off before it becomes billable.

Karthik
Director, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Burke <tburke@starlight.ai>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Purchase token request and line split for initial onboarding — APPROVED

Karthik/Ben/Monica — I approve the temporary spend cap of $20,000 for Starlight AI (Mar 1–May 31, 2027) for the pilot. Ben — please convert PROV-20270330-007 to PO-20270330-194 and apply the two-line-item structure as discussed (RED-LLM-COMPUTE, RED-LLM-STORAGE). Monica — loop Tim to confirm final normalized amounts and close the onboarding packet.

Tim — welcome aboard; we’ll send the formal PO and the vendor packet (W-9, banking, onboarding checklist) by end of day tomorrow.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Revenue Operations (acting)
Redwood Inference
